in_telugu.name: పిదామ్బర్
in_telugu.long_meaning: పేరేపోజేపోజేయేదోది ధోటియోధోటి పొజేపోజే ఆశేశపై పొజేపోజేయోయే ఆదేశ్యో ఆదేశ్యుదే.

in_marathi.name: Pitambar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Knowledge and Wisdom
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pitambar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Pitambar is derived from Sanskrit words ‘Pita’ meaning father and ‘Ambar’ meaning sky clad or dressed in the sky. This name is associated with Lord Vishnu and Lord Krishna who are considered as the embodiment of wisdom and knowledge. The name Pitambar signifies that the one who holds the wisdom of the universe and bestows it upon his devotees.

This name is associated with Lord Vishnu and Lord Krishna who are considered as the embodiment of wisdom and knowledge. The name Pitambar signifies that the one who holds the wisdom of the universe and bestows it upon his devotees.
